description: Source code for Opencart's Banner model handling CRUD operations for banners and their images in the admin design module.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Model class for managing banners and their images in the Opencart admin design module.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Creates a new banner record in the database, including associated images.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a specific banner.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Updates the banner's details and replaces its images.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Deletes a banner and its images from the database.

methods.name: getBanner
methods.description: Retrieves a specific banner record by ID.

methods.name: getBanners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of banners with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalBanners
methods.description: Returns the total count of banner records.

methods.name: addImage
methods.description: Adds an image record associated with a banner and language ID.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes all images associated with a specific banner.

methods.name: deleteImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes images associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves images for a specific banner and language.

methods.name: getImagesByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a specific language.
